name: Zack Reed
source:
The third-oldest brother of the Reed family. Zack is a cheerful and active person with a love of causing mischief. He's the type to freely show his emotions, and he's touchy-feely; he's like a puppy. Since Zack does things on his own before ordering others to, leadership isn't his forte. He's a hardowrking guy who proactively studies battle tactics he doesn't like and does routine, everyday tasks with no concern of his nobility.

His only concern was to join the chivalric order, so he had no interest in women. As a result, he has zero experience with romantic relationships. Having never read a book or seen a play about love or romance, Zack doesn't know how to deal with women, or the appropriate personal space to give them. Thanks to his good looks and noble background, is popular with women. Even so, Zack is so dense that he doesn't realise when a woman is cracking onto him.

His hobbies are eating, practicing his sword skills and sleeping. He enjoys taking a walk into town with his older brother, Adel, and finding something delicious to eat.
